data.body:
[P2] Preserve wrapper diagnostics when finalizing setup failures

Moving construction inside the catch sends setup failures through `unwrapInvocationFailure`, which discards wrapper diagnostics. If the second `Context.getAwsRequestId()` call throws `CompletionException(F)` with suppressed error `D`, where `F` is an `InternalError`, the caller now receives only `F`; `D` becomes unreachable. The base revision preserved the wrapper and its diagnostics. Transfer suppressed diagnostics from recognized setup wrappers before discarding them, excluding aliases that would create cycles, and extend `OwnedExecutorSetupFailureTest` with this case.
